title: S1/S3 source-grounded switched coupled coil charge/reservoir spark energy BIDI
source: Original Filsinger 4-spoken-edge 0-proven-pin midpoint transcript, and separately Smith/Kelly/Darrer coupled L1/L2 references; source owners from existing #1537; no same-original physical identity promoted

systems.S1: Centre-referenced secondary tank v=U-V with symmetric ideal +/-v/2; diode collector j=max((abs(v)/2-b-Vforward)/Rd,0), secondary shunt capacitor C, bank Cb, bleed Gbleed, on/off hysteretic spark Gspark.
systems.S3: Separately magnetically driven U-V coil, capacitor C across it, Cu/Cv from each coil terminal to M, explicit displacement-return states; positive diode OR ju=max((u-b-Vforward)/Rd,0), jv=max((v-b-Vforward)/Rd,0); capacitance matrix [[C+Cu,-C],[-C,C+Cv]]; output bank and spark as S1.
systems.common: Two inductively coupled coils state [i1,i2], magnetic energy 0.5*L1*i1²+M*i1*i2+0.5*L2*i2²; L1*L2>M²; primary drive source Vs(t), resistor losses R1,R2 and diode nonideal Vforward,Rd. Cbank*db/dt = jtotal-(Gbleed+Gspark*switch)*b.
systems.donor: Explicit SYNTHETIC active current ienv=0.005*vU, whose positive signed energy is integral(vU*ienv dt). It is a second prescribed source, NOT an Earth/air energy observation or model of the actual Earth.
systems.work: Wdriver+Wenv+Einitial=Wcopper1+Wcopper2+Wdiodes+Wbleed+Wspark+Efinal, Wdiodes=int(Vforward*jtotal + Rd*sum(jk²)), Wspark=int(Gspark*b²) over on intervals. Stored energy includes both coupled coils, all ground capacitors and output bank. No double counting of reactive circulation.
systems.numeric: Dimensionless model units only; L1=2,L2=1.5,M=.6,R1=.35,R2=.28,C=1,Cb=.65,Cu=.4,Cv=.55,Rd=.12,Vforward=.1,Gbleed=.018,Gspark=1.1,spark_on=.22,spark_off=.075,drive=2sin(t),duration=24pi. Not original device data.

results.both_zero_initial_without_sources: no spark, no useful output or losses
results.verification: 64/64 local exact SymPy 1.14 identities + switched ODE numerical ledgers PASS; no GitHub CI, no Agda kernel

inverse: Changing donor-positive signed Wenv need not increase spark work: S3 shows Wspark decreases as Efinal rises.
Driver input changes under external coupling; compare total signed drive, donor, heat, bank and final energy.
Nonlinear diode bank is NOT equal to the earlier phasor series RL constant.
Precharged bank emits finite switch pulse from initial storage without ongoing source.
S3 Cu/Cv provide explicit displacement return, cannot be replaced by assuming hard NST centre tap.
Other Filsinger reels, reported acoustic frequency, historical Smith/Kelly split 17+17 and 47nF must not be merged into these dimensionless model settings.
